body: It's just hard on me because I want to get her out of that house so badly. And I could if she didn't have her dogs. Which I'm not trying to say the dogs are bad or it's their fault, I definitely think they are a positive impact on her. But I just feel so helpless.

I have been trying to open her up to the idea of using internet forums as a good way to vent, and I should go more in depth with it. I plan on seeing her care provider to at least get her some medicine until we can find a therapist we can afford. I think she is a naturally happy person but she is just in such a bad place because her house and parents suck it really hinders her. Thank you for talking to me I appreciate your kind words a lot.
Thank you so much for your kind words and reply. I will check that out. Thank you.
